prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1124; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of lower back pain, muscle spasm, and reduced range of motion in the lumbar spine. No loss of consciousness was reported at the time of the incident. Initial examination showed tenderness over the paraspinal muscles, restricted forward flexion, and pain with extension. Neurological screening was within normal limits, and there were no signs of radiculopathy. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings.

Conservative management was initiated and consisted of a combination of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, home stretching program, and short-term use of muscle relaxants and anti-inflammatory medication as prescribed. The patient attended a total of 14 visits over the course of care. Pain levels decreased steadily over this period, and functional tolerance for sitting, standing, and lifting improved with each phase of rehabilitation.

At discharge, the patient reported minimal residual discomfort with occasional stiffness after prolonged positioning. Lumbar range of motion had returned to near baseline. The patient was discharged with a self-directed exercise plan and instructions to return if symptoms worsened.
